skill.summary: Turn podcast transcripts or audio files into a complete publishing package — SEO-optimized show notes, chapter timestamps, pull quotes, social clip suggestio...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Podcast Show Notes Generator.

- Generate SEO-optimized show notes, chapter timestamps, and pull quotes from podcast episodes (via transcript or audio).
- Suggest social clips, newsletter blurbs, YouTube/Spotify descriptions, and A/B title variations.
- Output includes guest bio, episode metadata extraction, and tag strategy.
- Handles both raw audio and transcript files, with automated transcription and speaker diarization.
- Produces publishing-ready assets for major platforms (Spotify, YouTube, Substack, etc.).
